content:
[Intro]
[Am]
[G]
[Am]

[Verse 1]
[Am]Now we've come to the age,
Where the splendour fades,
[G]And we look behind
[Am]drooping facades.
The glossy front's just fake,
The firm base breaks,
[G]as this doomed world
[Am]slowly decays.

[Interlude]
[Am]

[Verse 2]
[Am]Illusions fly high,
Nothing we don't try
[G]To build up fantasies
[Am]we can believe.
We dance, sing and play,
Cause we feel the strain
[G]of living at the end
[Am]of our time.

[Chorus]
[F]We have resigned to our fate
Afraid that our time is up
[Am]now.
[F]Though it's not quite too late,
if we take to action
[Am]now.

[Bridge]
[Bm]Our legacy
Fades and melts away,
[G]Cause tomorrow
[Em]may not ever be.
[Bm]So we dance and sing,
try to bear the thought
[G]Of approaching
[Em]the end of our
[Bm]time.

[Solo]
[Am]
[G]
[Am]
[G]
[Am]
[F]
[Am]
[F]
[Am]

[Outro]
[Bm]Our legacy
Fades and melts away,
[G]Cause tomorrow
[E]may not ever be.
[Bm]So we dance and sing,
try to bear the thought
[G]Cause tomorrow
[E]may not ever be.

title: Time To Turn
